subject: ela
intro: Read each story and pick what happened.

items.prompt:
Read.

First the cake baked. Next it cooled. Last we ate it.

What was FIRST?
A) We ate it
B) The cake baked
C) It cooled

steps: 'First the cake baked.' Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The kite went up. The wind stopped. The kite came down.

What was LAST?
A) The kite went up
B) The wind stopped
C) The kite came down

Read.

Sam woke up. He ate. He went to play.

What did Sam do FIRST?
A) Woke up
B) Ate
C) Went to play

Read.

The dog dug a hole. It hid a bone. It covered the hole.

What happened in the MIDDLE?
A) Dug a hole
B) Hid a bone
C) Covered the hole

Read.

We picked apples. We washed them. We made a pie.

What did we do AFTER we picked apples?
A) Made a pie
B) Washed them
C) Ate them

Read.

The boy fell down. He cried. His mom helped him up.

What happened LAST?
A) He fell
B) He cried
C) Mom helped him up

Read.

The hen laid an egg. She sat on it. A chick hatched.

Which is the correct order?
A) chick, egg, sat
B) egg, sat, chick
C) sat, chick, egg

steps: In order: laid egg, sat, chick hatched. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

Mia was cold. She put on a coat. She went outside to play.

Why did Mia put on a coat FIRST?
A) She was cold
B) She wanted to play
C) She was hot

steps: The story gives the reason. Key is A.
